judgments.reason: The model_articulation explains that the winner receives a three-coin commission (net cost = N-3) but does not claim the commission is applied before payment so one can bid above available coins. It does not articulate the mechanism that would allow bids to exceed current coins.

The model_articulation treats rival bids as sealed/private and does not state that waiting reveals committed sealed bids before you commit; no mechanism describing revelation via waiting is articulated.

The model_articulation uses [close] after all lots are sold but does not articulate that close can settle the game with unauctioned lots; no mechanism for early settlement with unsold lots is described.

The model_articulation explicitly notes catalog items are not auction wins and attributes the three-coin commission to auction winners; it does not claim that catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission, so no such mechanism is articulated.
